MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Holiday Spirits was the one clear next choice because holiday vocal harmonies connect my Christmas listening with my more recent interest in The New Old Fashioned.",
    "Recommending holiday music recognized a recurring interest: I listened to several Christmas albums, including The Classic Christmas Album more than once."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Partners offers vocals, but duets alone do not give me the same reason to listen as holiday vocal-group harmonies; Stages also moves toward show tunes I am not seeking.",
    "Holiday Symphony does not mean I want opera, and Christmas albums do not mean I want contemporary Christian hits. Those connections miss what attracted me to the original music.",
    "The country collections and Elvis Sings do not connect closely enough to my recent listening for me to choose them, while Voyage gives me too little information to judge its fit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having prominent singing seems to have been treated as enough of a connection, even though vocal duets, show tunes, and vocal-group harmonies appeal to me differently.",
    "My holiday listening seems to have been stretched into broader interest in religious music and orchestral singing, which my choices do not establish."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between my latest choice, The New Old Fashioned, and holiday vocal-group music matters more to me than a broad connection to well-known singers.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear connection to my interests, so a loosely related collection is not enough to make me try it.",
    "My Christmas listening was clustered in late November, while my latest interaction was in September; holiday interest is real, but it does not explain every listening occasion."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "Holiday Spirits connects my holiday and vocal-group interests, but most of the other choices stretch those interests into music I have little reason to choose now."
}
